title: Anatomy of a quality attribute scenario
description: A source of stimulus raises a stimulus that arrives at an artefact operating in a stated environment. The artefact produces a response, which is judged by a response measure. Example values come from the Meridian peak submission scenario.

regions.label: Environment: incident peak, CRM up or down

nodes.label: Source of stimulus
nodes.detail: Customers reporting a widespread equipment fault

nodes.label: Stimulus
nodes.detail: Valid submissions at 20 per second for ten minutes

nodes.label: Artefact
nodes.detail: Portal receipt API, excluding file upload

nodes.label: Response
nodes.detail: Stores the submission and handoff record, then returns a receipt

nodes.label: Response measure
nodes.detail: 95% of receipts within one second; no accepted submission lost
